topic: The Mars Climate Orbiter mission failure

scenes.beat: A mission begins a nine-month journey toward Mars
scenes.subject: a small Mars orbiter spacecraft between Earth and Mars
scenes.action: the spacecraft moves toward the distant red planet while the route feels precise and fragile
scenes.setting: deep space with Earth far behind and Mars clearly ahead
scenes.mood: quiet ambition with a sense of unresolved danger
scenes.camera: wide establishing shot with the spacecraft readable in the middle distance

scenes.beat: Two teams work with incompatible measurement systems
scenes.subject: one navigation engineer comparing two technical documents and instrument readouts
scenes.action: the two sets of measurements visibly disagree in scale and notation without showing readable words
scenes.setting: late-1990s mission-control workstation with paper, cables and a warning lamp
scenes.camera: medium over-the-shoulder shot focused on the physical mismatch

scenes.beat: A tiny conversion error shifts the intended trajectory
scenes.subject: a Mars orbiter and two diverging flight paths around Mars
scenes.action: the spacecraft follows the wrong arc while the intended path remains visibly separate
scenes.setting: stylized but physically legible space-science visualization
scenes.camera: high-angle orbital composition with clean negative space for later vector overlays

scenes.beat: The spacecraft approaches Mars on a dangerous path
scenes.subject: the small orbiter passing too close above Mars
scenes.action: the spacecraft skims the upper atmosphere instead of entering the planned orbit
scenes.setting: curved red Martian horizon with a thin atmospheric rim
scenes.camera: dramatic close approach with the planet dominating the lower frame

scenes.beat: Mission control realizes contact has disappeared
scenes.subject: an empty mission-control console with a silent telemetry display
scenes.action: a red warning reflection falls across the abandoned workstation after the signal vanishes
scenes.camera: slow-feeling close-up of the empty operator station

scenes.beat: The mission becomes a permanent lesson
scenes.subject: Mars filling the frame while a tiny spacecraft disappears behind its dark limb
scenes.action: the last signal fades as the spacecraft is lost from view
scenes.setting: quiet space around the red planet
scenes.camera: wide closing composition with a small subject and overwhelming planet
